what_happens: 351 tweets across 5 topics: sports, health, flood, terrorism, politics
Remove missing values and duplicate tweets, leaving 300 tweets
Lowercase; remove URLs, @mentions, RT, hashtag signs and symbols
80/20 stratified split: 240 training and 60 test tweets
Word TF-IDF (1-2 grams) plus character TF-IDF (3-5 grams)
Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM and Hybrid TF-IDF + SVM
Test-set metrics plus 5-fold x 5 repeat cross-validation
One transaction per tweet: its set of non-stopwords
Apriori and FP-Growth at 3% support give 21 identical itemsets
Support, confidence and lift; strongest rule is mental to health
